mentions.name: KeibiDrop
mentions.description: A tool for working with remote large data sets as if they were local. A daemon can be run on a user's own NAS, providing on-demand access to remote data from working machines, with use cases including post-production video work and data acquisition in digital forensics flows.
mentions.problem: Working with large data sets stored remotely is difficult compared to having them available locally.
mentions.audience: Post-production video professionals and digital forensics workflows
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working with remote large data sets as if they where local.

I made the project public on May, and now as September has arrived, you can work with post production videos anywhere in the world. You can run the daemon on your own NAS and access the data on-demand from your working machines.
mentions.author: coldstartops
